remarks: A perfect place to call home! This beautiful, light-filled Cape is available for year-long, short-term or flexible lease terms in highly desirable Cove! 36 Middlebury offers a remodeled, sun-drenched living room with fireplace (Duraflame), an open dining area with access to a deck & spacious, and a fully fenced level backyard. Enjoy the light-filled eat-in kitchen with further exterior access. The main level offers a bedroom with exceptional storage, a tastefully remodeled full bath with window, and additional under-stair storage.  Upstairs features a spacious primary bedroom with skylights and a generously sized third bedroom, also with skylights and seasonal water views! Additional highlights include a detached garage, a shed, 3 car driveway parking, and charming curb appeal! Enjoy a prime location just a short walk to Cove Island Park, featuring a green exercise area, a playground, grilling stations, as well as nearby tennis & basketball courts, and an ice skating rink.
